goal: Re-audit the BallRunnerHybrid Unity 6 project after the latest stabilization patches and identify the highest-value remaining work for a build-ready vertical slice.

phases.title: Final Stabilization Pass

tasks.title: Post-patch architecture and runtime risk audit

Focus on: direct Gameplay/MainMenu play safety, duplicate state/controller risks, gate trigger correctness, obstacle rebuild fairness, scene validation depth, test coverage adequacy, and any compile/runtime traps introduced by the recent changes. Return only strict JSON.
